prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile-first web landing page direction comp
Primary request: Design a shippable 9:16 portrait mobile web viewport for SettleUp, a product that starts from real bank transactions and turns them into shared friend-group expenses. This is a practical interface screenshot, not a poster, mood board, physical-device photograph, or concept-art scene.
Structure: a very slim top navigation with the SettleUp wordmark and a Sign in action; a dominant opening stage where one enlarged hand-drawn phone and its precise bank transaction are under inspection; one concise headline and one primary CTA remain immediately legible; the bottom of the viewport visibly begins a scroll transition, pulling back enough to hint that this phone belongs to a wider circle of connected friends. The composition should clearly support a later scroll-driven zoom-out into six interconnected rotating phones.
Direction: “The Shared Ledger Study,” industrial-design sketchbooks crossed with annotated bank ledgers. The phone, connector hints, arrows, and small notes are drawn with confident graphite and ink lines on tactile cream sketch paper. Use sparse crosshatching only to explain volume and focus. Notion-like visual quiet and spacing, but with unmistakable authored sketch character.
Color palette: mildly beige cream #F2EDE2 dominant; near-black warm graphite #242321 for type and drawing; restrained terracotta #D57B4E and sage #ABA784 for meaningful actions and status only.
Text (verbatim, no other prose): “SettleUp”, “Your bank knows what happened.”, “Share it with the people who were there.”, “Connect a bank”, “Sign in”, “Luna Pizza”, “$84.20”, “Jamie”, “Noor”, “Eli”.
Interaction cues: a small hand-inked scroll annotation may indicate that the view pulls back; connectors must read like physical tension lines with purpose, not decorative orbit lines.
Constraints: money and controls must look exact and trustworthy; practical accessible hierarchy; portrait phone-first composition; crisp readable UI type; one dominant visual move; no invented claims or metrics; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no stock photography; no generic rounded card grid; no giant floating app-store phone mockup; no neon; no purple; no watermarks; no illegible microtext; no extra text.
